$comment: Montage music: the user's NCS (NoCopyrightSounds) library (D413 item 2, D414). Settings > Clips > Montage music holds the folder, random or a fixed track, and how many recent tracks are not repeated. Each track has a credit record (artist, title, the NCS line, an optional link) read from the file's tags or from an 'Artist - Title [NCS Release]' file name, editable, stored at <data>/<credits>. NCS usage policy (ncs.io/usage-policy, read by the user's session 2026-11-21): use on YouTube and Twitch, monetised, is allowed when the artist and song are credited in the description; so a post with a library track always carries its credit, and a post with a track and no credit is never sent. A montage whose track is not from this library is rendered only and never auto-posted. Read by services/clip/montage_music.py and services/studio-ui (user-settings.mjs, montage-music.mjs) and services/posting/post-text.mjs.

identity.$comment: Codex verify (D414): a track's id is its size + the SHA-256 of the whole file, hashed once per path + size + modified time (cache below), off air only, at most maxBytes and maxSec per file
